hard_gate_policy: Only frames passing scale, species/action diversity, anatomy/prop logic, and DFT style/noise gates may be selected.

items.scale: pass: adult locker-room door, windows, locker bank, bench and violin case remain coherently larger/smaller than Abai at their real use scale; no miniature architecture.
items.species_action: pass: exactly one readable animal, photo-locked Abai, seated alone and opening the case; no supporting cast or duplicate cat.
items.anatomy_props: pass: two paws, two legs and one tail are traceable; one low-angle partly opened case contains exactly one structurally readable violin and one bow, with paw/lid contact intact.
items.style_noise: pass: DFT old-paper tempera/matte-gouache medium, controlled locker-room planes, crisp focal detail and low-noise background; no pseudo-text.
items.notes: Selected attempt_002 after rejecting attempt_001 for an over-open case lid; exact 1915x821.

items.scale: pass: elephant-sized exit has generous head/shoulder clearance; lockers, benches and room height stay functional for the full mixed-size cast.
items.species_action: pass: exactly one Abai cat, rabbit, sheep, old dog, elephant and fox; six exit/preparation phases differ in posture, direction, height and eye line rather than repeating one clothing action.
items.anatomy_props: pass: Abai has the natural irregular crown patch rather than a cap, holds the only violin and bow, and all six bodies/limbs remain distinct and grounded with no prop duplication.
items.style_noise: pass: DFT matte private-dress palette, restrained old-paper texture, readable silhouettes and no visible text/noise artifact.
items.notes: Selected attempt_004 as a controlled single-identity-anchor repair for Abai's natural crown patch. Attempts_001-003 remain rejected evidence and were not selected or chained. Exact 1915x821.

items.scale: pass: two-storey brick houses, doors, windows, roofs, street width and distant hall all dominate the single fox at believable town scale.
items.species_action: pass: exactly one fox, half-stepping out while holding the door and looking toward the distant hall; no cat, crowd or repeated pose.
items.anatomy_props: pass: fox limbs, paws, feet and one tail are traceable; door-hand contact and threshold weight transfer are credible, with no carried prop.
items.style_noise: pass: DFT blue-hour brick-town matte-gouache language, clean large shapes, controlled paper grain and low-noise empty street.
items.notes: Selected attempt_001; dimension-only final normalization, exact 1915x821.

items.scale: pass: shelter roof, bench, signpost, street and buildings provide adult-scale anchors; the elephant fits under the canopy with comfortable clearance.
items.species_action: pass: exactly one elephant calmly adjusts one sleeve under the shelter; no cat, duplicate elephant or background animal.
items.anatomy_props: pass: trunk, tusks, paws, feet and sleeve contact are coherent; blank weathered lower sign panel replaces the rejected pseudo-text.
items.style_noise: pass: DFT matte blue-hour palette, soft warm practical light and restrained clean surface detail with no illegible lettering.
items.notes: Selected attempt_002 after rejecting attempt_001 for lower-panel text artifact; exact 1915x821.

items.scale: pass: high aerial view keeps all animals much smaller than same-plane doors, floors, roads, shelter and the distant hall; no readability enlargement.
items.species_action: pass: exactly one elephant, bear, fox, Abai and rabbit converge from five different road vectors at offset stride phases; no duplicate species or formation line.
items.anatomy_props: pass: silhouettes, single tails, feet and travel directions remain readable; Abai carries one closed violin case without extra instrument or limb.
items.style_noise: pass: coherent DFT aerial town rendering with muted deep teal/brick palette, uncluttered road planes and controlled low-frequency paper texture.
items.notes: Existing approved selected attempt_001 retained without regeneration; exact 1915x821.
